verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a managed relay service with an API and dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents single-item relay creation, token issuance and expiration through the API or dashboard. Nothing describes batch or bulk actions across many relays or tokens, and a general API that a user could script against is only a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
